BiblicalUsage: Harpagmos is a prize seized and clung to, and it appears once, in the verse that defines humility. In Philippians 2:6 Christ, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God, which means he did not treat equality with God as something to grab and hold.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse turns every ambition I have upside down: the one who had everything to cling to let it go, and that is what makes him Lord.
